note: Pack groups for tools/mcp/pack/pack.js and the GUI page Claude. Patterns: * = any text. A skill folder or an MCP group that matches no group lands in `other`, never dropped. Hand-kept; titles here are the English fallback (the GUI has its own strings for the ids below).

groups.title: Modding
groups.what: Make and change mods: units, weapons, maps, text, bots, checks, two mods together, porting, testing, release.

groups.title: Playing
groups.what: Help for players: match-ups, what to buy, setting up a match, why the game fails.

groups.title: The three games and lookups
groups.what: What differs between MoW:AS2, AS64 and Gates of Hell, and lookups in the knowledge webs.

groups.title: ARSENAL window
groups.what: Let Claude use the ARSENAL window for you, and the rules for changing the window itself.

groups.title: RobZ Realism
groups.what: RobZ Realism: play it, write a sub-mod on top of it, run it on AS64, known issues.

other.title: Other
other.what: Pieces that are in no group yet.

all.title: Everything
all.what: Every skill, every MCP tool group and the ARSENAL window server.

mcpWhat.knowledge: Look up how the games behave: modding facts, known limits, differences between the games, the guide.
mcpWhat.mod: A whole mod: facts, new mod, check, fix, what it changes, generate, which file wins, upgrade, port plan, pack.
mcpWhat.together: Several mods at once: clashes, a patch mod that keeps both sides, multiplayer sync.
mcpWhat.units: Units: find, stats, change, equipment, look, entity facts.
mcpWhat.weapons: Weapons and balance: find and change a weapon, balance check, price.
mcpWhat.text: Game text: find and set names and translations.
mcpWhat.maps: Maps and missions: facts, clone a map, add a mode, place an object.
mcpWhat.bots: Bots: allow bots in a mode, bot buying recipes.
mcpWhat.play: The installed game: status, last log, crash, modes, bots, settings. Read only.
mcpWhat.coach: Advice for a match: gun against armour, armour of a unit, what an army can buy, counters.
mcpWhat.run: Start and drive the game for a test. Refused unless starting the game is allowed.
